What is an internal developer platform?
An internal developer platform (IDP) consists of a standardized set of self-service tools and technologies that developers need to create and deploy code.
Considerations when implementing developer portals in regulated enterprise environments
There is a trend in the industry at present around developer experience. At the center of this is the developer portal. However, if the portal is built quickly and executed without actually integrating or solving issues specific to that environment, it can result in wasted time and resources.

Tunnel

Cloudflare Tunnel
Cloudflare Tunnel provides you with a secure way to connect your resources to Cloudflare without a publicly routable IP address. With Tunnel, you do not send traffic to an external IP — instead, a lightweight daemon in your infrastructure (cloudflared) creates outbound-only connections to Cloudflare
